cohort: The study compared women with retained placenta after vaginal delivery to women with regular placental separation, all with singleton pregnancies in vertex presentation and no major fetal anomaly, delivering at >= 24 weeks of gestation.
finding: Retained placenta was directly related to previous uterine curettage and labour induction with prostaglandins, while it was inversely related to vaginal spontaneous delivery and higher Apgar scores at 1 minute.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery was inversely related to retained placenta.
